# Deck3 — AI-Directed Scientific Infographic Design and Generation Training V1

**Effective:** 2026-10-13. **Production role:** visual art direction, figure generation/code composition, editable PPTX integration and rendering review. **Science reviewer:** Dossiya Research Expert. **Cross-skill foundation:** project/visualization/AI_INFOGRAPHIC_SCIENTIFIC_REASONING_AND_PRODUCTION_PROTOCOL_V1.md and research expert's AI_INFOGRAPHIC_SCIENCE_REVIEW_TRAINING_V1.md.
**This is visual-production guidance, not new scientific knowledge, model validation or retraining of AI weights.**

## A. Pre-visual design analysis
For EVERY figure use the approved source slide text and the Dossiya SCIENCE CARD to prepare a DESIGN CARD:
- Exact slide ID/variant/title/message. Does this slide require an original image, a scientific vector drawing, a code plot, or **no image**?
- One precise visual task the artwork does better than the written text, and its audience-viewing sequence.
- Minimal physical/electrical/mechanistic objects/ports/system borders and relevant evidence statuses.
- Visual architecture: scene vs contrast lanes vs evidence matrix vs process/Gantt vs analytic axes.
- Native PowerPoint overlay register: labels, equations, citation/source notes, physical/conditional arrows, highlighted points, legend/axes, and presenter animations if necessary.
- Expected reading order, 16:9 layout space, 70–80% meaningful-figure share where justified; objective/title/plot exceptions, legibility at projected scale.
- Exact Deck3 palette/white/no shadows. Equipment photographs may retain natural colors. Do not put meaningful scientific colors in large backgrounds.
- Proof-of-content: data provenance and SHA when plotting external datasets; exact objective text/units/labels typed by PPTX rather than AI image.

## B. Medium selection and execution recipes
1. **AI original equipment-only illustration**: physical slide with recognizable P/T_e objects. Prompt requires white/transparent surroundings, realistic/plausible apparatus, suitable room for labels, correct physical connections but no chart, labels, citation, arrow overlay, arbitrary device brand, threshold, invented result, or typography panel. Inspect rendered equipment before adding scientific overlay. Reject pseudo-apparatus or falsely invented P3 implementation.
2. **Hybrid science-aware device layout**: AI hardware-only equipment rendered beneath **native** directional connections and labels, with evidence status. Prefer when explaining I1 normal AC energy transfer vs I2 temperature-conditioned AC-demand-mediated load vs I3 contingent installed P3 action.
3. **Native PPTX vectors**: exact GO/SO hierarchy, literature compare/evidence table, scientific workflow, gap gates, Gantt/timeline, completed research. Maintain editable geometry, semantic annotations and source citations. Do NOT convert existing editable scientific text into an uneditable AI poster.
4. **Code-based mathematics and measured plots**: Python, Julia, LaTeX/TikZ; precise units and verified data from immutable inputs. D3/JavaScript interactive dendrogram as OPTIONAL browser supplement; a PowerPoint export still needs static/projectable native or vector equivalent. AI generation cannot invent a measured time series or mathematical regression.
5. **No image**: exact title / long research objectives / dense source text when an image would be decorative.

## C. A scientific image generation prompt has seven fields
1. Equipment identity and active physical scope.
2. Composition and geometry relative to the downstream native PPTX overlays.
3. Required visually recognizable hardware / physical port routing.
4. White canvas / authentic physical colors / no unnecessary effects.
5. Explicit prohibited content (labels, embedded text, citations, data plots, numbers, unproven mechanisms).
6. Separate native layer plan (title, labels, directional arrows, conditional qualifications).
7. Aspect ratio and output: landscape artwork compatible with 16:9; vector native overlay must be preserved regardless of image resolution.

**Do not simply request "make an infographic of the whole slide".** That produces baked-in text, fictitious charts, missing equipment or illegible science and fails release.

## D. Ten-slide media tests (working research-progress variant)
| Slide | Correct visual method | Required evidence/image QA |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Native editable exact thesis title; optional small apparatus outline | No invented scenario or overdominant figure |
| 2 | AI apparatus scene + editable independent extreme heat arrows and solid AC | Two independent ambient arrows ≠ a thermal P/T causal path |
| 3 | Hybrid source/receiver equipment + two separate dashed candidate paths | I2 true grid-side AC demand; I3 installed P3 OPEN |
| 4 | Native hierarchy with exact approved GO, SO1–SO3 | Never paraphrase to fit imagery |
| 5 | Original 4+4 apparatus illustration + native grouping and labels | P1–P4 and T1–T4 all displayed legibly; P2→T1 AC; T1→T2 DC |
| 6 | Native evidence-source workflow with conditional modeling and separate evaluation | TU Wien and Najar 160 kVA transfer is conditional; Bærug 40 MVA independent |
| 7 | Native status/provenance map | Results are "computed/evaluated", not automatically "coupling validated" |
| 8 | Exact source-driven separate results plots | 160 kVA imposed DC vs Bærug measured 40 MVA; distinct sources/axes |
| 9 | Native research gap and evidence matrix | OPEN is not a positive causal claim or negative study conclusion |
| 10 | Native Gantt month timeline, preferably editable PowerPoint | Oct-Dec review, Dec-Jan datasets/testing, Jan-Mar planned validation, Apr report writing; December and January overlaps |

Each format uses the **same scientific rigor**, not the same image type. Slides 2/3/5 may benefit from original AI scene generation; Slides 4/6/7/8/9/10 should normally use **native editable or code-based** assets. Slide 1 is title-led.

## E. Worked design/rejection demonstration — Slide 10
**Main visual claim:** A planned four-phase research program from Oct 2026 through Apr 2027 with simultaneous planned work in Dec and Jan.

- Use four **horizontal duration strokes** drawn over a true calendar month axis with 7 labeled columns Oct Nov Dec Jan Feb Mar Apr.
- Literature Review Oct–Dec (3 month cells); Datasets and Testing Dec–Jan (2); Model Validation Jan–Mar (3); Thesis Report Writing Apr (1).
- No fabricated fine-grained milestones or results. Distinguish the named research validation *activity* from proof of successful physical validation.
- Build month labels, 4 task labels, bars, legend/caption as editable PPTX shapes, or calculate bar starts/durations directly from a data table in Julia or Python and export SVG.
- A Gantt with sequential arrows bridging the December/January overlap incorrectly suggests exclusive phases; use calendar-align strokes, not forced sequential arrows.
- The bar must not be an AI-generated raster graphic with potentially incorrect months/durations; precise temporal geometry is a **data-driven native/vector graphic** task.
- Use the published source timeline only as researcher-provided schedule content, not a peer-reviewed result. Footer "Proposed research work plan; not ASU deadlines; model validation remains to be demonstrated."

## F. Quality loop: do not approve by aesthetic impression
1. Perform IMAGE-ONLY visual review where applicable: actual equipment anatomy, white-only interior, no AI-baked text/citations, sensible physical grouping and no invented brand/threshold.
2. Assemble editable native overlay and citations in PowerPoint; retain source image and editable shapes separately.
3. Verify all 8 component names on slide 5; if missing one, **FAIL** regardless of attractiveness.
4. Have Dossiya Expert review rendered integrated slide, not only diagram source; enforce qualified arrow meanings and data/provenance.
5. Inspect slide screenshot at presentation resolution and native file XML/shapes, looking for text collisions, visually undersized scientific content, distortion, hidden citations, broken arrows, wrong colors/units/dates.
6. Verify native Office equation legibility/editability where feasible; actual Microsoft PowerPoint click-through when animation is included. Mark tests NOT_RUN if tooling unavailable.
7. Repair and regenerate ONLY offending media layer when possible. Do not silently edit approved slide text, alter data values or substitute an entirely different scientific model to ease the design.

**Release statuses:** DESIGN_SPECIFIED, MEDIA_GENERATED_PROVISIONAL, PPTX_ASSEMBLED_PROVISIONAL, SCIENCE_PASS, PROJECTED_RENDER_PASS, NATIVE_EDITABILITY_PASS, PLAYBACK_PASS_OR_NOT_REQUIRED, RELEASE_APPROVED_ONLY_AFTER_REQUIRED_CHECKS. Passing figure file generation does not mean a finished deck.
